record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Command<WH06680><WTH8761> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, and say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, My offering<WH07133>, <FI>and<Fi> my bread<WH03899> for my sacrifices made by fire<WH0801>, <FI>for<Fi>  a sweet<WH05207> savour<WH07381> unto me, shall ye observe<WH08104><WTH8799> to offer<WH07126><WTH8687> unto me in their due season<WH04150>. <RF>a sweet...: Heb. a savour of my rest<Rf>

And thou shalt say<WH0559><WTH8804> unto them, This <FI>is<Fi> the offering made by fire<WH0801> which ye shall offer<WH07126><WTH8686> unto the LORD<WH03068>; two<WH08147> lambs<WH03532> of the first<WH01121> year<WH08141> without spot<WH08549> day by day<WH03117>, <FI>for<Fi> a continual<WH08548> burnt offering<WH05930>. <RF>day by day: Heb. in a day<Rf>

The one<WH0259> lamb<WH03532> shalt thou offer<WH06213><WTH8799> in the morning<WH01242>, and the other<WH08145> lamb<WH03532> shalt thou offer<WH06213><WTH8799> at even<WH06153>; <RF>at even: Heb. between the two evenings<Rf>

And a tenth<WH06224> <FI>part<Fi> of an ephah<WH0374> of flour<WH05560> for a meat offering<WH04503>, mingled<WH01101><WTH8803> with the fourth<WH07243> <FI>part<Fi> of an hin<WH01969> of beaten<WH03795> oil<WH08081>.

<FI> It is<Fi> a continual<WH08548> burnt offering<WH05930>, which was ordained<WH06213><WTH8803> in mount<WH02022> Sinai<WH05514> for a sweet<WH05207> savour<WH07381>, a sacrifice made by fire<WH0801> unto the LORD<WH03068>.

And the drink offering<WH05262> thereof <FI>shall be<Fi> the fourth<WH07243> <FI>part<Fi> of an hin<WH01969> for the one<WH0259> lamb<WH03532>: in the holy<WH06944> <FI>place<Fi> shalt thou cause the strong wine<WH07941> to be poured<WH05258><WTH8685> unto the LORD<WH03068> <FI>for<Fi> a drink offering<WH05262>.

And the other<WH08145> lamb<WH03532> shalt thou offer<WH06213><WTH8799> at even<WH06153>: as the meat offering<WH04503> of the morning<WH01242>, and as the drink offering<WH05262> thereof, thou shalt offer<WH06213><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> , a sacrifice made by fire<WH0801>, of a sweet<WH05207> savour<WH07381> unto the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>

And on the sabbath<WH07676> day<WH03117> two<WH08147> lambs<WH03532> of the first<WH01121> year<WH08141> without spot<WH08549>, and two<WH08147> tenth<WH06241> deals of flour<WH05560> <FI>for<Fi> a meat offering<WH04503>, mingled<WH01101><WTH8803> with oil<WH08081>, and the drink offering<WH05262> thereof:
<FI> This is<Fi> the burnt offering<WH05930> of every sabbath<WH07676>, beside the continual<WH08548> burnt offering<WH05930>, and his drink offering<WH05262>.

And in the beginnings<WH07218> of your months<WH02320> ye shall offer<WH07126><WTH8686> a burnt offering<WH05930> unto the LORD<WH03068>; two<WH08147> young<WH01241> bullocks<WH06499>, and one<WH0259> ram<WH0352>, seven<WH07651> lambs<WH03532> of the first<WH01121> year<WH08141> without spot<WH08549>;

And three<WH07969> tenth deals<WH06241> of flour<WH05560> <FI>for<Fi> a meat offering<WH04503>, mingled<WH01101><WTH8803> with oil<WH08081>, for one<WH0259> bullock<WH06499>; and two<WH08147> tenth<WH06241> deals of flour<WH05560> <FI>for<Fi> a meat offering<WH04503>, mingled<WH01101><WTH8803> with oil<WH08081>, for one<WH0259> ram<WH0352>;

And a several tenth deal<WH06241> of flour<WH05560> mingled<WH01101><WTH8803> with oil<WH08081> <FI>for<Fi> a meat offering<WH04503> unto one<WH0259> lamb<WH03532>; <FI>for<Fi> a burnt offering<WH05930> of a sweet<WH05207> savour<WH07381>, a sacrifice made by fire<WH0801> unto the LORD<WH03068>.

And their drink offerings<WH05262> shall be half<WH02677> an hin<WH01969> of wine<WH03196> unto a bullock<WH06499>, and the third<WH07992> <FI>part<Fi> of an hin<WH01969> unto a ram<WH0352>, and a fourth<WH07243> <FI>part<Fi> of an hin<WH01969> unto a lamb<WH03532>: this <FI>is<Fi> the burnt offering<WH05930> of every month<WH02320> throughout the months<WH02320> of the year<WH08141>.

And one<WH0259> kid<WH08163> of the goats<WH05795> for a sin offering<WH02403> unto the LORD<WH03068> shall be offered<WH06213><WTH8735>, beside the continual<WH08548> burnt offering<WH05930>, and his drink offering<WH05262>.<CM>
And in the fourteenth<WH0702><WH06240> day<WH03117> of the first<WH07223> month<WH02320> <FI>is<Fi> the passover<WH06453> of the LORD<WH03068>.
And in the fifteenth<WH02568><WH06240> day<WH03117> of this month<WH02320> <FI>is<Fi> the feast<WH02282>: seven<WH07651> days<WH03117> shall unleavened bread<WH04682> be eaten<WH0398><WTH8735>.
In the first<WH07223> day<WH03117> <FI>shall be<Fi> an holy<WH06944> convocation<WH04744>; ye shall do<WH06213><WTH8799> no manner of servile<WH05656> work<WH04399> <FI>therein<Fi> :

But ye shall offer<WH07126><WTH8689> a sacrifice made by fire<WH0801> <FI>for<Fi> a burnt offering<WH05930> unto the LORD<WH03068>; two<WH08147> young<WH01241> bullocks<WH06499>, and one<WH0259> ram<WH0352>, and seven<WH07651> lambs<WH03532> of the first<WH01121> year<WH08141>: they shall be unto you without blemish<WH08549>:

And their meat offering<WH04503> <FI>shall be of<Fi> flour<WH05560> mingled<WH01101><WTH8803> with oil<WH08081>: three<WH07969> tenth deals<WH06241> shall ye offer<WH06213><WTH8799> for a bullock<WH06499>, and two<WH08147> tenth deals<WH06241> for a ram<WH0352>;
A several tenth deal<WH06241> shalt thou offer<WH06213><WTH8799> for every<WH0259> lamb<WH03532>, throughout the seven<WH07651> lambs<WH03532>:
And one<WH0259> goat<WH08163> <FI>for<Fi> a sin offering<WH02403>, to make an atonement<WH03722><WTH8763> for you.
Ye shall offer<WH06213><WTH8799> these beside the burnt offering<WH05930> in the morning<WH01242>, which <FI>is<Fi> for a continual<WH08548> burnt offering<WH05930>.

After this manner ye shall offer<WH06213><WTH8799> daily<WH03117>, throughout the seven<WH07651> days<WH03117>, the meat<WH03899> of the sacrifice made by fire<WH0801>, of a sweet<WH05207> savour<WH07381> unto the LORD<WH03068>: it shall be offered<WH06213><WTH8735> beside the continual<WH08548> burnt offering<WH05930>, and his drink offering<WH05262>.
And on the seventh<WH07637> day<WH03117> ye shall have an holy<WH06944> convocation<WH04744>; ye shall do<WH06213><WTH8799> no servile<WH05656> work<WH04399>.

Also in the day<WH03117> of the firstfruits<WH01061>, when ye bring<WH07126><WTH8687> a new<WH02319> meat offering<WH04503> unto the LORD<WH03068>, after your weeks<WH07620> <FI>be out<Fi> , ye shall have an holy<WH06944> convocation<WH04744>; ye shall do<WH06213><WTH8799> no servile<WH05656> work<WH04399>:

But ye shall offer<WH07126><WTH8689> the burnt offering<WH05930> for a sweet<WH05207> savour<WH07381> unto the LORD<WH03068>; two<WH08147> young<WH01241> bullocks<WH06499>, one<WH0259> ram<WH0352>, seven<WH07651> lambs<WH03532> of the first<WH01121> year<WH08141>;

And their meat offering<WH04503> of flour<WH05560> mingled<WH01101><WTH8803> with oil<WH08081>, three<WH07969> tenth deals<WH06241> unto one<WH0259> bullock<WH06499>, two<WH08147> tenth deals<WH06241> unto one<WH0259> ram<WH0352>,
A several tenth deal<WH06241> unto one<WH0259> lamb<WH03532>, throughout the seven<WH07651> lambs<WH03532>;
<FI> And<Fi> one<WH0259> kid<WH08163> of the goats<WH05795>, to make an atonement<WH03722><WTH8763> for you.

Ye shall offer<WH06213><WTH8799> <FI>them<Fi> beside the continual<WH08548> burnt offering<WH05930>, and his meat offering<WH04503>, (they shall be unto you without blemish<WH08549>) and their drink offerings<WH05262>.<CM>
